title: MermaidDiagram's specification states the opposite security posture from the code
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, one of three asked whether each component specification still describes the component that exists
details:
`components/MermaidDiagram.md:85` says the component initialises Mermaid with `securityLevel: "loose"`, and warns that the `chart` prop must therefore be trusted input. The frontmatter note at `:19` repeats it.

`src/components/MermaidDiagram.tsx:142` sets `securityLevel: "strict"` with `htmlLabels: false`. A test pins strict at `src/components/MermaidDiagram.test.tsx:27`, and `components/MarkdownViewer.md:204` describes the same component as strict. The specification is the stale side.

The code is the safer of the two, so the risk is not the one the warning describes. The cost is the interaction contract at `:89`: a `click` directive cannot fire a callback under strict, so a consumer wiring one from the documentation gets a silent no-op.

notes.text: Session agent confirmed every citation in this record against the tree at a374f2c before filing it.
